rule: Each task's pool is the first `forts` of its `candidates` seeds, in ascending order, whose build passes the embark rules (and, for MY1, the day-120 acceptance in pool/season0.pool.json). Pool id <season>-<task>-p<i> is the i-th accepted seed.
